# Contributing to nprcgenekeepr

Thank you for your interest. You do not need to write code to help: a clear
problem report from someone who manages a colony is one of the most useful
contributions this package can receive.

- **Report a problem or ask for a feature.** Open an
  [Issue](https://github.com/rmsharp/nprcgenekeepr/issues). No setup is needed.
  Please show the problem with the package's example data, and do not post real
  colony records, because Issues are public.
- **Change the code or the documentation.** Fork the repository, make your
  change on a branch, and open a pull request against `master`. A pull request
  includes tests for what it changes and passes the package check and lint.

The [contributor guide](https://rmsharp.github.io/nprcgenekeepr/articles/contributing.html)
says what to put in an Issue and walks through setting up a copy of the package,
where things live, running the tests, updating the documentation and proposing a
change. Its source is `vignettes/articles/contributing.qmd`.

Everyone taking part is asked to follow the
[code of conduct](https://github.com/rmsharp/nprcgenekeepr/blob/master/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
